title: 第13章 保持开心才能康复所以要撸猫-《同时被N个S级哨兵盯上怎么办》
content:
第(1/3)页

    “1VN？”秦夙惊呆了，“伴侣关系？这正经吗？！”

    “有什么好奇怪的？”魏知弦对她的质疑不以为然，“向导人少，而且无论基因如何改变，哨向之间依然存在天然的强绑定关系。尤其是你这种治愈型，根本离不开哨兵的保护，当然，哨兵也更加依赖你的疏导。”

    疏导，对啊。

    秦夙再仔细想想，她五天前对离颂做的那个，还不知道能不能称之为疏导。

    但是之前给谢尘无做的时候，确实需要拥抱啊，抚摸的。

    第一次就已经到了那个程度，以后再来几次，怕是难以避免会萌生队友之外的情愫。

    可是伴侣？跟谢尘无吗？

    还有……离颂？！

    还有这个魏知弦！！！

    她愕然的瞪着沙发上的人！

    见男人用修长的手指，推了推鼻梁上的眼镜。

    秦夙又不能直接问他是不是打着跟她结成伴侣的主意，焦躁无处发泄，又语气生硬的怼了人家一句，“你一个五感敏锐的哨兵，还需要戴眼镜？”

    魏知弦：？？？

    虽然一脸被秦夙冒犯的不悦，魏知弦还是解释了。

    他的眼镜是降低视觉敏感度的，不然看书时很容易穿透纸张，看到背面印刷的文字，会不舒服。

    秦夙也意识到自己有点无端找茬，也挺烦人的。

    后面不再说话，好好看书，免得再跟魏知弦聊出什么冲突。

    所谓腺体，是治愈型向导极小概率出现的二次发育。

    腺体能够生成和分泌向导素，并输送至身体每一寸皮肤，便于释放。

    有了向导素加持，治愈型向导在疏导时，会更加轻松和有效。

    目前现存向导中，只有首席向导，身为治愈型，且成功发育出了腺体。

    他的向导素极其香甜，每个有幸被其疏导过的哨兵，都对那种气味和感觉，难以忘怀。

    那么问题就来了，哨兵不会对向导的精神力成瘾。

    但对向导素，是极其容易上瘾的。

    秦夙结合自己的情况，光是想想就很绝望。

    她居然成了当前星球上，唯二可能产生向导素的向导。

    这种凤毛麟角般的存在，使得她变得如此稀有和珍贵。

    现在她已经开始发育腺体了，意味着她以后，很可能要用精神力和向导素一起给队里的哨兵做疏导。
    第(1/3)页

Page (1/3)

"1VN?" Qin Su was stunned, "Partnership? Is this serious?!"

"What's so strange?" Wei Zhixian disagreed with her question, "There are few guides, and no matter how the genes change, there is still a natural strong binding relationship between the sentinels. Especially for a healing type like you, you cannot do without the protection of the sentinels. Of course, the sentinels also rely more on your guidance."

Guidance, yes.

Qin Su thought about it carefully, and she didn't know if what she did to Li Song five days ago could be called grooming.

But when I did it to Xie Chenwu before, she really needed a hug and a touch.

It has already reached that level the first time. If we do it a few times in the future, I am afraid it will be inevitable that we will have feelings for people other than teammates.

​ But a partner?Have nothing to do with Xie Chen?

And...Li Song?!

And this Wei Zhixian!!!

She stared at the people on the sofa in shock!

I saw the man push up the glasses on the bridge of his nose with his slender fingers.

Qin Su couldn't directly ask him if he had the idea of ​​forming a partner with her. He had nowhere to vent his anxiety, so he said in a stiff tone, "You are a sentry with keen senses, and you still need to wear glasses?"

Wei Zhixian:???

Although he looked unhappy at being offended by Qin Su, Wei Zhixian still explained.

His glasses reduce visual sensitivity, otherwise it would be easy to penetrate the paper when reading, and it would be uncomfortable to see the text printed on the back.

Qin Su also realized that he was looking for trouble for no reason, which was quite annoying.

Don’t talk anymore and read your book carefully to avoid any further conflicts with Wei Zhixian.

The so-called gland is a secondary development of the healing guide with a very small probability.

The glands can produce and secrete guide hormones and transport them to every inch of skin in the body for easy release.

With the blessing of guide elements, healing guides will be more relaxed and effective when providing guidance.

Among the existing guides, only the chief guide is a healing type and has successfully developed glands.

His guide is extremely sweet, and every sentinel who is lucky enough to be guided by him will never forget the smell and feeling.

​Then the question arises, the sentinel will not be addicted to the guide’s mental power.

“But it’s extremely easy to become addicted to guide hormones.

Considering his own situation, Qin Su felt desperate just thinking about it.

She has actually become the only guide on the planet who can produce guide elements.

This rare existence makes her so rare and precious.

Now that she has begun to develop glands, it means that in the future, she will probably have to use her mental power and guide elements to guide the sentries in the team.
